title: wildmat: 2D Vec heap allocation on every call in hot loops
description: wildmat_match allocates a vec of vecs on every call. This is called in two hot paths: (1) list_active and list_newsgroups in reader/src/session/commands/list.rs iterate over the full group list calling matches_wildmat per group -- on a server with tens of thousands of groups every LIST command triggers that many heap allocations; (2) GroupFilter::accepts in validation.rs is called per newsgroup per incoming article (up to MAX_NEWSGROUPS=100 groups per article). Approaches to fix: (a) Flatten the 2D Vec to a single Vec<bool> with manual index arithmetic to reduce allocator round-trips; (b) Use a stack-allocated small-vec for short group names -- group names are typically under 64 bytes and patterns under 32 bytes so the DP table is under 2048 cells; (c) For the LIST hot path, pass a pre-compiled pattern object rather than re-parsing the raw string on every group. Option (a) is the minimum viable fix with no dependency changes.
